primitives.verbatim_quote: **George Pickens (DAL vs WAS, $6,300)** — the consensus WR value of the slate.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'V_c': 'Consensus value function (dimensionless)', 'S': 'Salary (USD)', 'T': 'Target share (% of team targets)', 'M': 'Matchup quality (0–1 scale)'}
primitives.assumptions: V_c(S,T,M) = f(T,M)/S is maximized under fixed budget constraints.

primitives.name: Target Volume Bargain Signal
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Matthew Golden (GB @ NYJ, $4,700)** — FTN "Way Too Cheap" (9/15): 12 targets in Wk1, most routes on team, 95% outside (FTN Stats); draws Azareye'h Thomas who "struggled against the Titans in Week 1." RotoWire cash WR + bargain bin (9/18).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'TV': 'Target volume (number of targets)', 'P': 'Price (USD)', 'R': 'Route type percentage (outside routes %)', 'O': 'Opponent weakness indicator (0–1)'}
primitives.assumptions: TV/P * R * O > threshold implies undervalued play.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If O < 0.3 or R < 0.8, signal degrades due to poor matchup or low route diversity.

layer2.mapping: Target volume signal is embedded in GSE's kernel of expected route distribution and opponent defense metrics.
layer2.telemetry: Projected targets and air-yards from FTN and FantasyPros stats.

primitives.name: High Price Hero Indicator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Justin Jefferson (MIN @ CHI, $7,800)** — DK Buzz Factor "Building" (9/18): "Natural correlation with the Wentz value build." FantasyPros core stud (9/18): 37.5% target share / 0.31 TPRR / 8-92-2 in Wk1; "projects as the WR3 this week." RotoWire honorable mention high-priced hero (9/18).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P_h': 'High price threshold (USD)', 'TS': 'Target share (%)', 'TPRR': 'Target per reception ratio', 'Y': 'Projected yards (air yards)', 'TD': 'Projected touchdowns'}
primitives.assumptions: P_h > threshold && TS ≥ 35% && TPRR ≥ 0.3 implies high-value hero.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If Y < 80 or TD < 0.5, hero status fails due to low production expectation.

layer2.mapping: Hero indicator aligns with GSI's probabilistic model of elite performance under QB influence.
layer2.telemetry: Projected fantasy points based on TPRR, target share, and QB correlation from FantasyPros.

These operators form a dual space where empirical observables (targets, TPRR, salary) are mapped to latent variables (matchup quality, QB correlation). For example, Pickens' V_c remains robust despite minor injury concerns, whereas Jefferson’s HPH depends on Wentz’s performance. This interplay enables a layered reasoning engine capable of handling uncertainty in real-time.
